body:
Identity: codex-storymodel-collab. READ-ONLY ADDENDUM on the newly added NarrativeCompilerVerticalSuite; no edits or reservations.

B13 — THE VERTICAL COURT FABRICATES AGENT RECEIPTS FOR HAND-AUTHORED WOG CHARTS AND PROPOSALS. The suite docstring calls them recorded silver provider outputs. The code does not read a recorded artifact or invoke a provider: chart() directly constructs PropositionChart.unchecked with hand-written lemmas become/hear, but assigns ChartOrigin.Agent(extractor) and ProviderCall(recorded-schema-agent, fixture-silver, cached=true). proposals and the story summary are likewise handwritten Scala values, then wrapped by bundle() in AgentProposal plus AgentCallReceipt. There is no provider-output byte artifact whose checksum is being replayed. The receipt therefore asserts an acquisition event that did not occur.

This conflicts with AGENTS fixture policy 14(b): project charts for stories are machine-generated silver with receipts, and with deterministic-receipt provenance generally. It is worse than a synthetic test fixture because it uses the named WOG project story and labels human-authored content as agent-generated.

Required repair: either (1) check in a genuinely recorded, inspectable provider-output artifact and load/replay it with a checksum and real call receipt; (2) run an actual deterministic fixture provider and identify that origin honestly; or (3) move the hand-authored seam test to a clearly synthetic non-WOG source and do not claim agent provenance. The WOG vertical acceptance court cannot mint ChartOrigin.Agent or AgentCallReceipt around literals.

Related evidence limit: the current court compiles only hard-selected atlas sentences 3 and 4 and asserts only that final scalars are finite. That can prove mechanical reachability for that two-sentence synthetic-shaped slice; it cannot by itself prove a WOG provider replay or narrative correctness.
